name: Dripping Paste
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: and a quarter of flour
ingredients.originalText: two pounds and a quarter of flour

instructions.text: To a pound of fresh beef-dripping that has been nicely clarified, allow two pounds and a quarter of flour.
Put the flour into a large pan, and mix the dripping with it, rubbing it into the flour with your hands till it is thoroughly incorporated.
Make it into a stiff dough with a little cold water.

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. To a pound of fresh beef-dripping that has been nicely clarified, allow two pounds and a quarter of flour.
2. Put the flour into a large pan, and mix the dripping with it, rubbing it into the flour with your hands till it is thoroughly incorporated.
3. Make it into a stiff dough with a little cold water.
4. Roll it out twice.
